The '''Walk of Fame''' is a sub-location of {{Zone|The Mountaintop}}. It can be entered by speaking to the {{NPCSprite|Argofay Doorholder}} if you've obtained the {{Item|Supreme Timecharm}} and serves as the ultimate checklist for the Rift Dimension.

== Features ==
The '''Walk of Fame''' is split up into multiple rooms based on [[Timecharms]]:

=== Chicken N Egg Timecharm ===
The first room is based on the {{zone|West Village}}. It requires a {{Item|Warding Diamathame}} to trace a heart-shaped outline. Switching items or failing to trace the floating heart will result in the outline being reset.

Successfully tracing the heart summons {{NPCSprite|Roosterzilla}}, who requires the {{Item|Chicken N Egg Timecharm}} to continue.

=== mrahcemiT esrevrorriM ===
The second room is based on the {{zone|Mirrorverse}}. The player can see blocks on the other side of a mirror that shows where to jump. The {{NPCSprite|Lost Wizard}} is at the end and requires the {{Item|mrahcemiT esrevrorriM}} to continue.

=== SkyBlock Citizen Timecharm ===
The third room is based on the {{zone|Village Plaza}}. The player has to walk past [[Temporal Pillar]]s to speak to {{NPCSprite|Noway}}, who requires the {{Item|SkyBlock Citizen Timecharm}} to continue.

=== Living Timecharm ===
The fourth room is based on the {{zone|Living Stillness}}. The player has to use a {{Item|Frozen Water Pungi}} and [[Pickaxes|Pickaxe]] to mine a living metal snake. Mining a snake summons an {{NPCSprite|Autonull;Autonull}} that requires the {{Item|Living Timecharm}} to continue.

=== Globulate Timecharm ===
The fifth room is based on the {{zone|Colosseum (Rift)}}. The player needs to hit several {{MobSprite|Globowl}}s into a giant {{MobSprite|Slime}} named B in the center. After knocking several {{MobSprite|Globowl}}s into B, a {{NPCSprite|Blobbercyst;Blobbercyst}} appears. It requires the {{Item|Globulate Timecharm}} to continue.

=== Vampiric Timecharm ===
The sixth room is based on the {{zone|Stillgore Château}}. The player needs to break {{Green|2}} [[Stillgore_Château#Blood_Effigies|Blood Effigies]]. Both must be broken within {{Green|1min 30s}} of each other before the first resets.

The first [[Stillgore_Château#Blood_Effigies|Blood Effigy]] can be reached by:
# Jumping to the first platform to the right of the center platform
# Turning right and jumping onto the platform where a tree is found
# Climbing up using the ladder
# Jumping across the branches and onto a floating island

The second [[Stillgore_Château#Blood_Effigies|Blood Effigy]] can be reached by:
# Jumping to the first platform to the left of the center platform
# Walking to the far left corner
# Turn right and going up the ladder near the castle
# Turn left and crossing into the room
# Once in the room, go left and up the stairs
# Jump until reaching the Effigy

Breaking both [[Stillgore_Château#Blood_Effigies|Blood Effigies]] summons {{NPCSprite|Spike (NPC);Spike}}, who requires the {{Item|Vampiric Timecharm}} to continue.

=== Celestial Timecharm ===
{{Main|Cerebral Citadel}}

The seventh room is based on {{zone|The Mountaintop}}. {{NPCSprite|Madame Eleanor Q. Goldsworth II}} requires the {{Item|Celestial Timecharm}} to continue to the {{zone|Wizardman Bureau}}.

This room also connects to the {{zone|Cerebral Citadel}}. It requires showing {{Item|Shen's Ringalia}} to {{NPCSprite|Obo}}.
